developers_page_title: AutoRig Developer API: Rig and Animate 3D Models by REST
seo_developers_title: AutoRig Developer API: Rig and Animate 3D Models by REST
seo_developers_description: AutoRig REST API: create a task from a link or upload, poll its status, download the rigged GLB, FBX and animation files. API keys, endpoints and curl examples.
developers_intro: Use the AutoRig HTTP API to create tasks from a link or an upload, poll until the task is done, then download the rigged model, animation files and related files via stable URLs. A task is the same V3 task as on the site, and its result is the V3 viewer with animation clips and exports.
dev_v3_title: How a task works in V3
dev_v3_input: A task starts from any input: a 3D model (GLB, FBX, OBJ or a ZIP with textures), a picture, a picture of a car, or text. The calls below create a task from a link or an upload; the examples use a model link.
dev_v3_rig: The V3 conveyor builds the skeleton and skin from the geometry in seconds and retargets the animation clips at once. Quality checks run in the background.
dev_v3_viewer: The result is the task page https://autorig.online/task?id=TASK_ID: the V3 viewer with the clips and the AI agent chat.
dev_v3_files: The viewer offers GLB, FBX, USDZ, ZIP, Unity package and Blender downloads. The endpoints below have stable URLs, and cached-files lists every file the task has with its download URL.
dev_flow_1: POST /api/task/create with a link (JSON with input_url, or multipart with input_url or a file).
dev_u3d_body: U3D uploads use a dedicated provider key and isolated OAuth credentials. An AutoRig admin API key is neither required nor accepted. Open the provider page for the ready curl example, live readiness status, admin-only key copy button, and agent skill.
